correctness.rationale: The proof classifies all subalgebras into z-containing subspaces and graphs over totally isotropic subspaces, derives an exact graph-pair permutability criterion, and counts the nonorthogonal pairs using subspace-lattice Möbius inversion and symplectic quotients. The m=1 specialization matches arXiv:2609.19086v1, and exhaustive enumeration of H_2(F_2) matches the m=2 formula exactly.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The source paper poses the higher-Heisenberg question and solves m=1 only. Searches for higher-rank subalgebra commutativity, equivalent symplectic formulations, and extraspecial-group variants found no general formula or rank transition. A broad 2009 subgroup-commutativity paper was not fully inspected and remains a residual risk for the prime-field group corollary.

value.rationale: The result answers the natural higher-rank problem for every finite field, supplies a uniform exact formula and a closed m=2 case, and reveals a sharp large-field transition from 0 to 5/9 to 1 that is not visible in the previously known rank-one computation.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
